verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio's own docs list setting up endpoints from a team configuration and running teams in a Docker container, so the product can expose agents as callable endpoints. Nothing shows a managed or hosted runtime: deployment appears to be self-hosted containers, and the endpoint feature is a single bullet with no depth. Missing for 10: a managed/hosted runtime for agent deployment, documented API endpoint invocation details (auth, scaling, request schema), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can deploy an agent to a managed runtime and call it as an API endpoint
